response.text:
I can do that, but deleting slides is a destructive action so I need one quick confirmation before I proceed.

Please confirm these items (reply with “Yes — go ahead” plus any choices, or change them):

1) Target deck — paste the shared link (or confirm the link you already gave is the one to edit). I need access to that file.  
2) Exact action — permanently delete slides 14 and 15 from that shared copy (they will be removed and slide numbers will shift), or instead move them to a backup deck/archive? (Options: "delete" or "move to backup".)  
3) Backup preference — if you choose delete, should I first make a copy named "[original name] — backup before removing slides" and keep the two slides there? (Options: "make backup" or "no backup".)

If you confirm the link and reply with:
- "Delete, make backup" — I'll create the backup copy and then remove slides 14–15 from the shared file.
- "Delete, no backup" — I'll remove slides 14–15 from the shared file.
- "Move to backup" — I'll copy slides 14–15 into a new deck and remove them from the shared file.

Once you confirm and provide/verify the link, I’ll proceed.
